profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer |
profile.summary:
Lead Full-Stack Engineer with 16+ years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale applications using microservices and cloud-native technologies. Experienced in modernizing legacy platforms into scalable Spring Boot-based systems, improving resiliency, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

Hands-on expertise in designing and building distributed systems using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, and event-driven architectures. Strong background in CI/CD automation, performance optimization, observability, secure API integrations, and cloud-native design principles.

Led modernization initiatives by deploying containerized microservices on Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms, leveraging Rancher-managed clusters, Spinnaker-based CI/CD pipelines, and secure platform integrations to deliver highly available and resilient applications.

Passionate about engineering excellence, mentoring teams, and collaborating with architects, product owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that drive business value.

positions.title: Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead modernization of legacy SOA/OSB applications into scalable Java and Spring Boot microservices.
Drive cloud-native deployments on Kubernetes, OpenShift, and Amazon EKS, with CI/CD automation using Jenkins and Spinnaker.
Leverage MongoDB, Redis, and HashiCorp Vault for data management, caching, and secure secrets management.
Lead technical design, Agile delivery, and team mentoring; improved deployment efficiency by 25% through CI/CD and test automation.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Developed efficient batch processing solutions leveraging Spring Batch to handle large data sets across interconnected systems, optimizing data flow and performance. Designed and implemented interactive front-end applications using JSF, RichFaces, and PrimeFaces, enhancing user engagement and functionality. Built robust back-end services with Spring Data JPA, ensuring reliable data persistence and efficient transaction management for scalable applications. Monitored and optimized application performance using APM tools like New Relic and AppDynamics, proactively identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks. Collaborated with cross-functional teams, integrating components and services to deliver cohesive, high-performing systems that meet business needs.
